PenteFino lab authorization — program opus-lab-docq
Owner-declared lab targets (André, 2026-10-25): docq.app and *.docq.app.
Allowed: passive subdomain enumeration, DNS resolution, HTTP probing, nuclei safe_read_only templates.
Rate limit: <= 10 req/s per worker. No intrusive, stateful or lab_only templates.
Any other domain is out of scope.
